profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Amazon Web Services
profile.summary:
Software engineer with eight years’ experience building web and enterprise applications. Passionate about Agile Software Development and it’s focus on value delivery, response to change, collaboration and teamwork.

Solid knowledge of the Java platform, both for development as for tuning and problem solving, acquired through eight years’ experience.

Specialties:
- Lean/Agile software development
- Web development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, Backbone, Rails, Django)
- Development and deployment on the JVM platform (Java, JEE, Spring, Clojure)
- Scripting languages (Python, Ruby)
- Service Oriented Architectures
- WebLogic Server, Oracle Service Bus
- Experienced with UNIX and GNU/Linux

positions.title: Independent Consultant
positions.description:
Lead a team migrating web services to an SOA architecture on top of WebLogic Server and Oracle Service Bus.

Helped diagnose and fix performance problems in production, for an application used in hospitals nation wide.

positions.title: Technical lead
positions.description:
Introduced Agile Software Development to the company. Implemented XP practices like TDD, peer review an continuous integration.

Led a Scrum team in building a budgetary control application for the Mexican government to keep track of progress made on highway construction across the country. Biweekly releases were critical to building a successful product where many stakeholders —five different government agencies— were involved. The application was built with the Spring framework, JavaScript and JavaScript libraries like jQuery and Backbone.js.

Drove the adoption of Distributed Version Control Systems at JWM Solutions, which greatly simplified the collaboration with remote teams and enabled the definition of better development workflows, branching strategies and release management practices.

Coached and mentored new team members: helping them improve their Java and JavaScript knowledge; teaching them Git for version control; introducing them to TDD and continuous integration; setting up a peer review process.

Created and organized a space for “tech talks” at JWM Solutions, to interact with and learn from co-workers. This was a great opportunity to learn new things, not necessarily work related, and build a positive work environment.

positions.title: JEE Consultant
positions.description:
PoC projects for our clients, focusing on adopting SOA architectures (on top of WebLobic, Oracle Servic Bus and Oracle Coherence).

Worked with various companies to find and solve issues on applications in production, mainly on JEE application servers.

Wrote a framework on top of Fast Search (enterprise search, now Microsoft Fast) to simplify and speed up the development of web applications with custom search needs. In use in various online shopping portals and news agencies' websites in Mexico.

positions.title: Presales Consultant (contractor)
positions.description:
Worked with the commercial team to sell BEA System’s SOA products, conducting presentations, workshops and developing proof of concept prototypes. Worked with financial institutions, the telecommunications sector and government agencies.

Imparted training courses for BEA’s products like AquaLogic Service Bus and WebLogic Portal.
